Project ZAMAN — Design Overview
The Oscillation of Eras

A Soulslike set in an early 20th century world fractured by the misuse of the soul.

Engine: Undecided · New Input System Genre: 3D Action / Adventure · Soulslike Aesthetic Inspirations: Lies of P, Bloodborne

Synopsis
A Masonic cult misidentifies Immaculate Thought — the soul’s capacity to process meaning without contradiction at extreme speed — as time manipulation. Repeated exploitation shatters the soul, triggering Soul Fission and an irreversible desynchronization of reality: the Oscillation of Eras. The protagonist, an unnamed orphan bound in a double straitjacket, must navigate a broken world where restoration is impossible and adaptation is the only path forward.

Protagonist — Subject-002





























AttributeDetailIdentityUnnamed orphan. 190 cm, lean-muscled. Bound in a double straitjacket. Exists entirely outside the cult’s Hebrew naming system — a deliberate outsider.MiraclesPerceptual time quantification · Epistemological object contact · Silent connection across distance. All require internal calm to function.Dual FormsAn original empathetic/mediator self and a shadow form driven by vacancy and destruction — held in tension throughout the narrative.AlinaCaretaker turned eternal bond. Her death — accidental gunfire during a confrontation with Noam — is the Oscillation’s emotional catalyst. Her final instruction: stand for good, end evil, stay himself, resist the shadow.NoamAntagonist. Same age as MC, physically similar. Groomed by his Masonic parents. His childhood report of MC’s miracles inadvertently triggered the cult’s extraction. Progressively decayed into full ideologue.

The Cult

























LayerNameSubtitlePublic FaceAnthropos (Greek)“In Service of All Mankind”Inner OrderGibborim (Hebrew — “those who overreached divinity”)“We Who Stood Beyond the Threshold”Science DivisionAxiom (public only, no private name)—
Symbols: White snake = Gibborim (hissing, anchor-hook tail) · Black snake = Axiom (silent, no hook)

World Lore

Ashbourne Children’s Home — Secretly owned by the cult as a capability pipeline.
The Desert — MC’s psychological landscape.
The Hope Entity — MC’s childhood self. Reconnection is not a return to innocence, but a reconciliation with the self.
The 11th Chamber — Contains Alina’s preserved corpse. Its unveiling caused both of MC’s soul-forms to fluctuate simultaneously, triggering the Oscillation.
Subject-001 (The Instrument) — Post-fission entity retaining precision and clarity but lacking empathy and creativity. Hums a distorted lullaby. Shimmering skin with sigil markings. Eventual ally to MC.


Core Principles
01 — Naming Framework Arabic is used for core metaphysical truths, world concepts, and protagonist-facing ideas. Hebrew is used for the cult, its rituals, subjects, and esoteric terminology. The protagonist is named in neither — reinforcing his outsider status.
02 — The Irreversibility Principle Nothing is restored. Only adaptation is possible. The Oscillation is permanent; the world cannot be reset or saved in the conventional sense.
03 — Hope as Integration The game’s central theme is adaptation, not restoration. Hope is understood as the integration of fragmented selfhood — not salvation, not escape.
04 — Dual Identity MC’s two forms are not good vs. evil in a binary sense. The shadow form is driven by vacancy; the original by empathy. The tension between them is the game’s internal drama.

Project ZAMAN is an original Soulslike in active development.
